limits: Local Chrome with desktop mouse and mobile touch emulation; no physical-device, Safari/Firefox or comprehensive screen-reader certification.
No deployment, live account, paid generation, publication, checkout or production traffic acceptance.

Layout shifts and long tasks are bounded local samples. The recorded cls is the sum of qualifying entries, not a field session-window metric; no industry-wide performance score or field CWV guarantee.
Fully disabling all JavaScript still leaves the existing framework streaming shell. Blocking external client bundles preserves content and native disclosures after inline stream completion.
The new UI reuses the existing galaxy asset with no additional animation dependency, bitmap or rendering context. Bundle size is recorded rather than claimed cost-free.
Public copy, metadata, scripts, social artifacts and selected compiled markers were checked locally; this does not establish that every live page is clean.
